sources.title: Avas Ride journey and car fare datasets, Datathon 2026 release v1.0
sources.publisher: Avas Ride, distributed by Maldives Bureau of Statistics
sources.grain: One supplied ride record; unique journeys and people cannot be verified without IDs
sources.clock: Source date_started clock; timezone not documented
sources.license_status: Public Datathon participant dataset; no separate reuse licence in archive

coverage.spatial_basis: Strict containment in existing OSM-derived physical-island polygons; no snapping

limitations: These are historical supplied ride records, not live traffic or all taxi journeys.
Completed records combine payment_completed and ride_completed as an explicit status-name assumption; no status dictionary is supplied.
Expired records also contain positive distance/time fields and are excluded from trip-duration and speed profiles; expiration does not establish an unserved passenger.
No journey, passenger or vehicle ID is supplied. Counts describe records, not unique people, fleet size or occupancy.
The source clock timezone and the exact definition of time_sec are undocumented; trip minutes are not pickup waiting time or a calibrated road congestion measure.
Recorded speed is summed distance divided by summed time. Trip mix and stopping can change it; it is not a measured road-segment speed or causal congestion index.

Coarse zones reuse existing island geometry. Hulhumalé and Hulhulé use the app's derived causeway partition, not official neighbourhood or terminal boundaries; unmatched points are not snapped onto land.
Only aggregate groups of at least 30 records are published; no raw coordinates or individual timestamps are retained.

Car fare cells are interpreted as nominal MVR for the supplied Malé city zone matrix; the CSV has no explicit currency, effective date, surcharge or fare-rule documentation. They are context, not quoted current fares.
